gloss: fiercely; intensely; violently; with full force

definitions.gloss: fiercely; intensely; with great force or vigor
definitions.explanation: Describes something done with extreme force, intensity, or ferocity. Used for storms, wind, attacks, hard work, and strong emotions. Implies something overwhelming in its strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{猛烈|もうれつ}に⟦{吹|ふ}いている→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{猛烈|もうれつ}に⟦{勉強|べんきょう}した→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I studied intensely before the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反論|はんろん}→反論：08677_hanron⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{猛烈|もうれつ}に⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧し、⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かなかった→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: He fiercely resisted the counterargument and did not give an inch.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {猛烈|もうれつ}に: fiercely, intensely — implies overwhelming force or vigor; strong nuance
- ⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: intensely, violently — general term for intensity; widely applicable
- ⟦{強烈|きょうれつ}→強烈：15109_kyouretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: strongly, powerfully — emphasizes the power of an impact or impression
- ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: desperately — emphasizes desperate effort rather than forceful intensity

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猛烈|もうれつ}に⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work fiercely (like a 猛烈社員, a workaholic)
- {猛烈|もうれつ}な⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧: a ferocious typhoon
- {猛烈|もうれつ}に⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧: to get furiously angry
